text:
Alex P: Quick sync — console observability status. Retention migration for traces is blocking more items than I expected. Need clear owners for: trace hook rollout, dashboard error-analysis views, and retention cutover plan. Who can pick these up? @Maria G @Jun L :eyes:

Maria G: I can take error-analysis views (front-end + kql queries). Can we define the exact criteria? e.g. top-10 error groups, regression alert thresholds, and a sample query set to validate?

Alex P: Thanks Maria. Minimal acceptance criteria: 1) Dashboard surfaces top-10 by freq and rate-of-change, 2) An alert rule that fires on 20% regression over 1h, 3) a short runnable query set we can include in the eval job.

Jun L: I can own trace hook rollout but need runtime team's signoff on the hook patch. Jun -> @Ryan M, can you confirm the runtime perf test window?

Ryan M: pinged. We have a perf slot Wed 09:00 PT. Need the hook PR 24h before for the perf harness. Also, the hook touches samplers; please add perf counters in the patch: trace.hooked_count and trace.hook_latency_ms.

Jun L: Noted. Will add counters. Also flagging that the retention migration plan depends on storage team's schema change (shard_key update). Sophie, any visibility from infra on when shard_key rollout can land?

Sophie R: Infra tentative for next Friday (2026-03-27), but it's gated on a DB migration rollback test. If that fails, we'll push a week. I'll post the rollback test runbook by EOD tomorrow.

Alex P: Ok — proposal: staggered cutover. Day 0: deploy trace hooks (canary 5% -> 25%), Day 2: enable retention policy soft-limit (30d -> 15d), Day 4: full enforcement. That minimizes impact if shard_key migration slips. Thoughts?

Maria G: Staggered sounds safe. For dashboards, I'll target Day 1 for the error view soft launch (samples only) so UX and queries can be validated before full enforcement.

Jun L: Agree. Question: who will own rollback playbook if hooks cause latency regressions? We should name an owner for pager escalation.

Alex P: Let's make Ryan M on-call owner for hook regressions (he's runtime). Devex will own dashboard rollback. I'll add both to the playbook.

obs-bot: Deploy slot reserved: perf-harness-wed-0900-pt -> ticket INFRA-3421.

Ryan M: I'll draft the rollback runbook this afternoon and post as a gist. Also adding a quick perf check snippet you can reuse:
```
# run perf harness (local)
./perf_harness --target http://staging:8080 --concurrency 200 --duration 60s --metrics trace.hook_latency_ms
```

Alex P: thx. Two quick asks: 1) Jun, post the hook PR by Tue noon so we can run perf slot, 2) Sophie, please confirm rollback test by EOD tomorrow. I'll update the roadmap doc with the staggered dates once both confirm.

Jun L: Will do. PR pinged to reviewers: @Maria G @Sophie R @Ryan M.

Sophie R: I'll confirm after today's infra stand. If the rollback runbook reveals extra risk, I'll note the potential week delay in the roadmap.

Maria G: One more item — QA will need sample traces to validate error grouping. Can we add a small script to generate synthetic error traces? Jun, could you add a generator stub to the hook PR?

Jun L: Yep, adding a small generator and instructions in the PR description.

Alex P: Great. I'll follow up in the roadmap doc and ping this thread when dates are updated. If anyone needs to reassign owners, reply here. :thumbsup:
